crossRefs.note: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.
Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?
David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in…
David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.
Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all…
For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
